worldcombat.skill.superfang.summary: Measure the target's vitals with the front fangs, then bite off half of its current HP: no attack-versus-defence, a fixed share of what is left. Best against a full-health, high-HP target and weaker as it gets low, so it opens or breaks a shield rather than finishes.
The bite severs %1$s fixed damage: half of the target's current HP plus a little flesh the fangs carry off. It skips attack-versus-defence and ignores armour; only type immunity and native reductions stop it.
It pounces up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block fang radius.
After the bite the fangs stay on the target for %1$s while the user holds position; a target low on HP loses less to it.
worldcombat.skill.superfang.patient.on: Patient style: the carried-off flesh is ×1.6 and the hold is longer, but the wind-up is 3 ticks longer and the cooldown 8 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.superfang.patient.off: Skimming style: faster to cast and quicker to recover, but the carried-off damage is ×0.8.
worldcombat.skill.superfang.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.superfang.growth.0: From level %1$s the hold rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.superfang.use.0: Bite off half of the target's current HP
worldcombat.skill.superfang.use.1: Cut a high-HP target down early
worldcombat.skill.superfang.use.2: Break a shield with damage that ignores attack and defence
worldcombat.skill.superfang.preference.p: On: the carried-off flesh is ×1.6 and the hold is longer, but the wind-up is 3 ticks longer and the cooldown 8 ticks longer. Off: a skimming bite - faster to cast and recover, but the carried-off damage is ×0.8.
worldcombat.skill.superfang.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first; larger chases harder.

Below this current-HP ratio the user stops using Super Fang and leaves the cast to other moves. Raise it to only sever a still-thick target; lower it to keep severing even when little is left (small gain).
It pounces in a straight line and latches onto any non-allied living body it catches on the way, not necessarily the one aimed at; being blocked by terrain or finishing the pounce without a bite means it misses and deals nothing.
